Source: PMC 2005 Burkina Faso Cholera Epidemic Study
Description: Peer-reviewed study: Epidémie de choléra au Burkina Faso en 2005 - epidemiological and diagnostic aspects. Contains historical data 1971-1974 and 2005 epidemic data.

Source: WHO Disease Outbreak News 2001 West Africa Cholera
Description: WHO Disease Outbreak News update: Cholera in West Africa - Update. Documents 2001 outbreak in Ourgaye district with 314 cases, 6 deaths, 1.9% CFR.

Source: Resolve to Save Lives - Epidemics That Didn't Happen 2022 Cholera Burkina Faso
Description: Case study documenting successful 2021 cholera containment in Burkina Faso. Confirms 2 imported cases from Niger, 0 deaths, 0% CFR, rapid response. Also confirms absence since 2011.

Source: Xinhua French News - Cholera Epidemic Eastern Burkina Faso 2022
Description: Xinhua French news report: Épidémie de choléra dans l'est du Burkina Faso. Documents July 2022 outbreak in Kantchari, Tapoa Province with initial confirmed case.

Source: WHO AFRO Monthly Regional Cholera Bulletin January 2025
Description: WHO AFRO Monthly Cholera Bulletin January 2025. Confirms Burkina Faso absent from list of 14 affected countries, supporting zero-transmission assessment for 2022-2024.

Source: WHO 1996 Disease Outbreak News Cholera in Africa
Description: WHO Disease Outbreak News 1996: cholera cases reported in Burkina Faso during February 12-15, 1996 among other African countries. Confirms presence but no case counts.

Source: Pan African Medical Journal - 2005 Burkina Faso Cholera
Description: Pan African Medical Journal peer-reviewed publication confirming 2005 epidemic: 1050 cholera-like diarrhea cases, 121 confirmed V. cholerae. Confirms no cases after 2005.

Source: Wakat Sera - Cholera Cases in Kantchari 2022
Description: Burkina Faso national news outlet confirming cholera cases at Kantchari in Eastern Burkina Faso July 2022. Confirms ministry of health declaration of epidemic.

Source: Nations Encyclopedia WHO Cholera Deaths Database
Description: WHO cholera statistics database showing Burkina Faso cholera deaths. Confirms 16 deaths in 2005 epidemic. Derived from WHO official annual reporting to Member States.

Source: UN Press Release West Africa Cholera Forum 2005
Description: UN press release August 25, 2005 for West African Cholera Forum. Contains early 2005 interim count: 295 cases and 8 deaths as of August 2005 in Burkina Faso. Part of broader West Africa sub-region update (24621 total cases).

Source: Cholera Factsheet Burkina Faso 2017 - Plateforme Choléra
Description: Plateforme Choléra 2017 factsheet for Burkina Faso. Contains key historical data: 2011 outbreak (20 cases/2 deaths, Gorom-Gorom, September), 2012 outbreak (143 cases/7 deaths, Sahel, August-November), 2005-2017 aggregate surveillance data.

Source: UNICEF Burkina Faso Humanitarian Situation Report 2025
Description: UNICEF Burkina Faso Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1 (January-April 2025). Documents 2025 cholera outbreaks: more than 550 infections and 24 deaths in Central Sahel region, refugee-hosting areas and border regions affected.

Source: ReliefWeb West and Central Africa Snapshot October 2022
Description: ReliefWeb humanitarian snapshot October 4-10, 2022. Documents Burkina Faso cholera outbreak since October 2021: 12,517 cases and 254 deaths (CFR 2.0%) as of October 4, 2022. South-west region most affected.
